items.title: How a 52-Year-Old Can Turn $425,000 Into a Monthly Paycheck Machine by 62
items.summary: The yield you chase at 52 could quietly cannibalize the very nest egg you need at 62. Before you reach for the biggest monthly payout, understand the compounding trap hiding inside each income tier.

items.title: The Portfolio Blueprint for Building $50,000 a Month in Dividend Income
items.summary: Chasing a $50,000 monthly dividend stream sounds like a math problem, but the yield you pick determines whether your portfolio funds four decades of freedom or quietly cannibalizes itself while the checks keep arriving.

items.title: The 4% Rule vs. a Dividend Paycheck: Which Makes $1.25 Million Last Longer?
items.summary: A $1.25 million nest egg can fund a very different retirement depending on one number: your withdrawal yield. The gap between a conservative dividend portfolio and an aggressive one swings your annual income by tens of thousands of dollars, but the safer-looking choice does not always win.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Reaches $5.5 Billion Talc Settlement To Close Years Of Lawsuits
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) agreed to a US$5.5b settlement to resolve tens of thousands of talc baby powder lawsuits. The deal ends decades of litigation over alleged health risks tied to the company’s talc-based products. The settlement follows years of high profile trials and failed bankruptcy attempts related to the talc claims.
